membership: Eight unchanged baseline campaign images, including 6x2 degradation cases and 3x4/12x1 layouts; one synthetic signal family.
scope: Complete native candidate pipelines from untouched rasters through detected layout/calibration, tracing, existing validity/recovery and canonical export. These do not replace the separate full application selection/fallback evaluation.
learnedModel: Felix M1 fold 0, thirteen semantic channels, original patch dimensions, CPU two threads, no mirroring, float32 accumulator; no claim to reproduce the upstream M3 ensemble.
adoption: Requires complete paired output, fidelity and coverage gates plus independently verified calibration and lead identity. Missing semantic evidence is a failed admission gate. This development comparison cannot by itself authorize production adoption.
